department_definitions.AI: AI and machine learning research, applied research, model development, and AI/ML engineering. Use evidence about the person's role; working at an AI company alone is insufficient.
department_definitions.Product: Product management, product design, product operations, Product Marketing, and Product Partnerships, including embedded product/platform partnerships. Applied research alone does not establish Product membership; require evidence of one of the included functions.
department_definitions.Infrastructure: Cloud, compute, storage, networking, platform infrastructure, SRE, and developer infrastructure. Include physical/data-center infrastructure when the supplied role explicitly concerns it.
department_definitions.Engineering: Software, systems, hardware, and engineering leadership or individual contributor roles. Use the actual engineering function in the supplied evidence; a generic leader or partnerships title alone is insufficient.
